spec.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: sol_mahmut_vn_watchful, one production knee-up light-novel dialogue portrait for Unaware of My Demise.

Image 1 is the existing newly painted OpenAI mahmut composed master and the ONLY edit target: lock its exact character identity, costume construction, accessories, proportions, portrait crop, three-quarter orientation and painterly Gothic-anime finish. This is a new distinct expression/body-language variant, not a duplicate neutral image. Preserve fine colored linework, softly cel-shaded adult face, matte cloth, worn leather/metal, cool ambient light and restrained warm rim.

Identity invariants: Adult Mahmut, age 28: exactly the same mature face, tousled dark-brown hair, amber-brown eyes, subtle stubble, repaired gunmetal half-plate, worn leather straps, gloves and matte oxblood scarf-cloak. Preserve the eight-point red/silver chest star and the small round empty black socket immediately above it. Preserve the sheathed sword and plain hilt socket. No crown, new heraldry, drawn blade or changed armor.

Change only this acting: Watchful: focused amber-brown eyes looking farther toward viewer-right, lips lightly pressed, chin drawn in slightly as if listening. His upper body turns only a few degrees toward the unseen sound; his right gauntleted hand lifts beside the outer cloak edge to upper-waist height in a small cautionary pause gesture, while the left lightly steadies the sheathed sword. The star and empty socket stay clear. Alert, not frightened or angry.

Composition invariants: vertical 2:3, match the master camera distance and knee-up crop; full hood/hair and shoulders inside frame, face at the same height and scale. Face and gaze toward VIEWER-RIGHT, for the left dialogue slot. Keep hands, bell/sword hilt and all acting above the bottom third and fully inside the canvas. Preserve safe room around the head, elbows and props; the lower knee-up cloth crop is intentional. Do not add boots or a floor. Request the master's native 1024x1536 canvas; never upscale a smaller image.

Anatomy constraint: exactly TWO arms and TWO hands total. Reposition the existing free hand; completely erase its previous hand/finger pose instead of leaving it on the belt. Never add a third arm or hand. Hands connect to the matching sleeve and wrist.

Output: one finished standalone character with TRUE TRANSPARENT ALPHA outside the silhouette and in gaps between arms, cloak and props. Empty space must be fully transparent: remove any backdrop or diffuse halo from the edit target, with no dark/brown vignette, haze, shadow, green screen or painted checkerboard. No scenery, aura, particles, cast shadow, frame, caption, letters, UI, watermark, second character, or expression grid. Retain the exact face and outfit; produce the requested clearly distinguishable, anatomically correct acting.
